notes.title: V.1.7.3 Update Plan
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34382884/ce2fe53a4cdcd5cbe0ac36bcaf8d6f7a9e154337.png
Dear player,
We are finally getting a big version update!
The update is scheduled to close the server for 4 hours at 02:00 UTC on December 11th (21:00 EST on December 10th).
I believe that everyone is looking forward to the content of the upcoming update. The specific update list is as follows:

Fixed:
-Fixed the issue of unable to go over while waiting
-Fixed LIV function

Gameplay:
-Added swimming feature, now you can move freely in the water.
-Update the map-the island in the sea, the vegetation on the island is more dense now, please be careful of the assassins in the grass.
-Remake most of the housing areas, remake all room types, add new areas such as Villa, Forest Park, Beach, Lamu Island.
The new Red Zone system is more dangerous in the wild.
-Added Daily Leaderboards, which show the top ten players with yesterday's wins. Priority is ranked by the number of wins, followed by kills, and finally by damages.
-Added cosmos support
-Increase 98k damage.
-Increase landmine damage.
-Improve the damage reduction effect of Military Helmet / Military Vest.
-Remove landmine from airdrop and increase Military Helmet / Military Vest.
-Optimized the small map following icon after death.
-Adjust email input location.

UI:
-Added color for messages that you or your teammates killed others, and that you or your teammates were killed by others.

Sound effects:
-Improve the overall sound effect and enhance the sense of orientation.
-Add beach, coast, and fire related background sound effects.
-Optimize explosion-related sound effects.

notes.title: V.1.5.5 update list
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34382884/21ab36d5f1cf0d86a90e3b327d843bda3e7c687a.png

Fixed:
- Fixed a stuck location in the scene.
- Optimize Oculus related performance consumption.

Gameplay:
1.Adjusted damage caused by firearm type
- Submachine guns.
Hitting body damage increased from 100% to 105%
Hitting the upper arms and thighs damage increased from 50% to 65%
Hitting hands increased from 30% to 39%
- Shotguns.
Hitting the upper arms and thighs damage reduced from 50% to 45%
Hitting hands damage reduced from 30% to 27%
- Assault rifles.
Bullet to the Head damage increased from 230% to 235%
- Sniper guns.
Hitting body damage increased from 110% to 130%

2.Added submachine gun M10 and assault rifle AKM and gunstock(M10).

3. Adjusted the probability of all gun items appearing on the map. 

4. The backpack mode has added a Sliding/Multiple selection methods and a new item selection method can be selected in the settings.

In addition, after the server was maintained this afternoon. In order to avoid all kinds of problems related to season time caused by DST and non-daylight saving time. We will adjust the time of the server to non-daylight saving time. The time of the server is eastern standard time (EST), which will be one hour earlier than the previous DST.
There are two main effects to players:
1. The record time under the name of the lobby panel was previously recorded and displayed by EDT (EDT), and will be recorded and displayed by EST after maintenance this afternoon.
2.The refresh time of leaderboards, which was previously refreshed and displayed by 24:00 EDT (EDT), we will be refreshed and displayed by EST after the update.

notes.title: THE LAST PLAYER: VR Battle Royal EA version coming soon. EA S1 Tournament total prize of $ 2000, Come on!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34382884/d647cec9acb15c0a80034bad795046f321111e93.jpg
Hi everyone!

After a long beta test, THE LAST PLAYER: VR Battle Royale is finally meeting with you! The EA version will be released on August 7th at 9:00 PDT (16:00 UTC, 12:00 EDT).

During this year, domestic and overseas players joined our game testing and provided us with a lot of valuable feedback to help us improve the quality of the game, thank you all.

When the game is released that day, we will open the EA S1 Tournament!

The game server includes Europe&Amercian server and Asian server, and player data for the two area servers are not linked. Both area servers will operate in the EA S1 tournament, with each player only allowing to select one of the area servers to participate in the tournament. The S1 Tournament consists of two stages: S1-A and S1-B. There are two schedules, which are the points rankings and the finals. The schedule of points ranking for each stage is as follows:
AS server EA S1-A starting and ending time:
August 7th 23:59:59 (GMT+8)--September 7th 23:59:59 (GMT+8)

AS server EA S1-B starting and ending time:
September 9th 00:00:00 (GMT+8)--October 8th 23:59:59 (GMT+8)

EU&NA server EA S1-A starting and ending time:
August 7 at 11:59:59 (EDT)--September 7 at 11:59:59 (EDT)

EU&NA server EA S1-B starting and ending time:
September 8th, 12:00:00 (EDT)--October 8th, 11:59:59 (EDT)

After the end of each stage of the competition, the top will be cleared. We will invite the top 30 players in each area server of each stage to participate in the finals:

The finals scheduled for each stage of the competition are as follows:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34382884/37879b13b4e31e9c70166379207368fe96bfc640.png

The top 10 players for each tournament stage of each area server will win a prize:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34382884/d8a6c4353a76061b0c00ea559520e26f3b7ceb0e.png

We may adjust the rules of the game according to the actual situation. We will announce the detailed final rules and specific time one week before the finals, and we will email the top 30 players for each tournament stage of each area server. If you want to enter the competition, please fill in your email address correctly.
In order to get faster information. Please pay attention to our Discord: https://discord.gg/fhNMTfJ
Finally, thank you again for your support and help, we will continue to optimize and improve the quality of the game.
Let us fight together in the battle royale game!

G- Virus Studio

notes.title: New version of the competition registration notice
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34382884/d788b918724463e90aa5508851e08b4843654873.jpg
All previous keys have been completely destroyed.
Most of the features of the new version have been completed and we are in the final stages of version optimization.

Before the new version was released, we plan to organize a small-scale new version of the test competition. 
-The competition time is June 22nd and June 23rd(UTC:03:00-04:00 PM, EDT:11:00-12:00 AM).
-If you would like to participate in the competition, please make sure you will participate in the competition during that time.

We will select 30 players from all the players who signed up for the competition to participate in this game.
The rules for selecting players are as follow: 
-the contribution to our game, the participation enthusiasm of the previous game, and the order of registration of the game.
-When you sign up for the competition, we will by default comply with our confidentiality agreement: Videos, pictures and some game details about this version of our game will not be disclosed until our game is released.
-If you have any feedback on the new version of the game, please contact me in private.
-The deadline for registration is June 16th.
-On June 21st, I will send the KEY to the new version of the competition to 30 players and will destroy these keys on June 24th.

The registration link (opened) is as follows:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScZBOWDptRYGi6hZYXflGrTvXWBL11fMA42RO8JNd4soYuDKA/viewform?usp=pp_url
The points and bonus rules for this competition are the same as the weekly rules of the PRE S1 Tournament.

Bonus allocations are as follows:
-The two match-day points are accumulated, and the total points of the ranking and bonus are allocated as follows:
#1 - $30,  #2 - $20,  #3 - $15,  #4 - $5,  #5 - $5,  #6 - $5,  #7 - $5,  #8 - $5,  #9 - $5,  #10 - $5.
Rules:
 -The score rules are judged based on the number of wins,  total damage value, and the total amount of kills. Calculate the scores of the per player through a formula and rank them. (Per game: #1 +8 points, #2 + 4 points, #3 +2 points, #4 and #5+ 1 points, killed 1 person + 1 points. If the points are the same, the total damage value is high for the player, ranking it in the front.)
-The game is all single-row games, please don’t form a team to enter CUSTOM MATCH.
-No AI is involved.
